verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a CLI and an embeddable programmatic API (runMC, reference docs), so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file and markdown docs are documentation, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
